purpose: Bounded feasibility comparison of metallic 2D workfunction; not final publication evidence
scientific_focus: element physical descriptors and environment-conditioned contributions
split: 70/15/15 percent chemical systems, SHA256 c2db-wf-v1-seed42 salt, all phases of a chemistry together

training.loss: MSE on training-only standardized workfunction; unique-material weights one
training.selection: Minimum validation MAE in eV, earliest tie
training.feature_scaling: unchanged fixed standardized physical20 table; no additional scaling
training.paired_order: same seed42 permutations at each epoch

test_policy: Trainer parses only train/validation labels; score all fixed checkpoints once after all3 fits; no test-based tuning. Source-wide labels already audited descriptively, no completely unexposed-source claim.
reporting: Record MAE/RMSE/R2; one row per qualified material, mother weights coincide with record weights; training-mean baseline

decision.predictive_feasibility: Validation R2>=0.70 and MAE >=25% lower than training-mean baseline; operational pilot criterion
decision.environment_increment: compare environment gate to both controls; single-seed improvement is preliminary and cannot prove mechanism or robust superiority
decision.failure: No parameter sweep or automatic extension on this split; retain failure and diagnose the specific evidence

explanation_policy: Gate values are modulation, not importance; no explanation release before usable prediction. Static scaling does not control all additional MLP capacity; element-conditioned/capacity controls required if proceeding to contribution claims.

scope.source: C2DB snapshot referenced by official NIST JARVIS catalog, Figshare file28682010
scope.metallic: source gap exactly0, metadata filter only; gap is not model input
scope.workfunction: reported scalar wf in eV; no face-resolved or experimental workfunction claim
scope.spin: one reported computed state per id; no invented nonmagnetic label
scope.inputs: structure-derived originalphysical20+context37 only; no gap,wf,etot,efermi,raman calculated-property features

supplementary_phase_control: Within-test reduced-composition groups with >=2 structures: separately center target and prediction on each composition; equal composition weights for MAE/RMSE/R2. Fixed before fits; supplementary only, no training/selection/filter use, no required substitution pairs.
